checks.method_or_action: GET; complete GitHub sign-in, sign out, and sign in again
checks.setup: Use the same GitHub account on both sign-ins; retain an identifiable saved draft.
checks.expected_behavior: Sign-in returns to /profile.html and later sign-ins recover the same account and draft.

checks.method_or_action: GET with session; compare maintained profile before and after a GitHub username/display-name change
checks.setup: Use an account controlled by the reviewer; the account maps GitHub numeric ID to an internal UUID.
checks.expected_behavior: Changing a GitHub name does not create a second internal profile or change its ownership.

checks.method_or_action: Inspect the GitHub authorization request and consent screen
checks.setup: Start a fresh sign-in; inspect the scope query parameter.
checks.expected_behavior: Only read:user is requested; no repository-write permission is requested.

checks.method_or_action: Enter an approved Algoma address; select Send verification code; read its mailbox
checks.setup: Reviewer controls an algomau.ca mailbox; production Google mailer URL and matching private secrets configured.
checks.expected_behavior: A short-lived challenge is delivered to the signed-in student's approved-domain mailbox. Domain configuration must be reviewed separately; the current relay only accepts algomau.ca.

checks.method_or_action: POST JSON {email}; try an outside domain and algomau.ca.example.test
checks.setup: Use the frontend Origin and a session cookie; do not use someone else's mailbox.
checks.expected_behavior: Unapproved domain is rejected with HTTP 400 and no affiliation is granted.

checks.method_or_action: POST JSON {code} twice using the same successfully verified code
checks.setup: Obtain and use one valid challenge through the normal mailbox flow.
checks.expected_behavior: First valid use succeeds; a second use is refused without reusing the challenge.

checks.method_or_action: POST an expired challenge code
checks.setup: Operator may set VERIFICATION_CODE_TTL_MINUTES from 1 to 30; request a new challenge and wait past its configured expiry.
checks.expected_behavior: Expired code is refused. Assessed expiry is at most 30 minutes.

checks.method_or_action: Repeat POST requests immediately; submit five wrong six-digit codes for a fresh challenge
checks.setup: Use your own mailbox. Failed delivery requests also consume request limits; do not exhaust another reviewer's account.
checks.expected_behavior: Server limits message requests to one per minute and five per hour per account, and limits wrong attempts to five per challenge; recovery messages explain waiting or requesting a new challenge.

checks.method_or_action: Sign out, then sign in using the already-verified GitHub account
checks.setup: Complete affiliation verification once, save a draft, then sign out.
checks.expected_behavior: Profile editor reopens without requiring another email challenge.

checks.method_or_action: PUT a draft and GET the public directory without a session
checks.setup: Create an identifiable new draft through /profile.html and save without publishing.
checks.expected_behavior: Draft is maintained privately and absent from public directory and public profile responses.

checks.method_or_action: Edit and save headline, biography, availability, standardized skills, HTTPS professional links, GitHub link and optional location
checks.setup: Shared R1 skills must first be loaded; save the draft, refresh, and compare fields.
checks.expected_behavior: Structured professional fields can be maintained and restored after refresh.

checks.method_or_action: GET shared skills; PUT profile skills selected from that set; try an unknown skill value
checks.setup: Load fixtures/skills.json through backend/seed-release1.js. Production returned the expected 24 shared skills after fixture import and a subsequent backend redeployment.
checks.expected_behavior: Only shared standardized skills are selectable/public filter values. Unknown values are rejected by the profile API rather than creating duplicates.

checks.method_or_action: Choose each supplied PDF in the profile editor
checks.setup: Download all four R2 PDFs from Moodle folder 3925; PDFs are selected locally, not preloaded on the server.
checks.expected_behavior: PDF import accepts the supplied files and reasonable student PDFs.

checks.method_or_action: Review extracted skill, education, experience and professional-link candidates
checks.setup: Use resume_clean_single_column.pdf and resume_layout_stress.pdf; inspect minimal fixture separately.
checks.expected_behavior: Editable source-backed candidates are offered where present. Sparse files do not acquire invented entries; mixed column text may need manual correction.

checks.method_or_action: Edit one candidate; select it; leave another unchecked; choose Apply selected suggestions
checks.setup: Import a fixture; all candidate checkboxes start unchecked.
checks.expected_behavior: Only explicitly selected candidates are applied, using the reviewer's edits. Unchecked candidates can be rejected by leaving them unselected.

checks.method_or_action: Set identifiable manual fields, import and re-import PDFs without selecting Apply
checks.setup: Record current field values before each import.
checks.expected_behavior: Selecting or re-selecting a PDF alone does not overwrite maintained fields or save/publish the profile.

checks.method_or_action: Select a malformed PDF or a PDF with no useful extractable text
checks.setup: Keep identifiable unsaved manual values before the test; current limit is 10 MB and the first eight pages.
checks.expected_behavior: Clear recoverable message is shown; manual editing remains possible and existing field values are preserved.

checks.method_or_action: Toggle availability and professional-link visibility; publish; inspect public response
checks.setup: Set identifiable values in a private draft. The original PDF is not uploaded or persisted; there is no original-PDF download route.
checks.expected_behavior: Student can control availability/links. Discard-original alternative: source PDF is never retained in server storage or made publicly downloadable.

checks.method_or_action: GET public JSON with no session after publishing hidden availability and links
checks.setup: Publish a profile with both visibility controls off; use its U{internal-UUID} public ID.
checks.expected_behavior: Private availability and links are not revealed by public JSON; email, codes and draft JSON are not exposed. Current implementation publishes [] and {} for hidden values.

checks.method_or_action: Select Preview before publishing
checks.setup: Populate a draft and turn at least one visibility control off.
checks.expected_behavior: Public preview distinguishes hidden availability/links from information intended for publication.

checks.method_or_action: POST publish, then POST unpublish; reopen the maintained profile
checks.setup: Save required name, headline and program; requests need session and frontend Origin.
checks.expected_behavior: Publishing exposes the public snapshot; unpublishing hides it while keeping the maintained draft.

checks.method_or_action: Publish/unpublish and reload the public directory without redeploying
checks.setup: Use an identifiable profile and clear directory filters. R1 fixtures have been imported; the API returned 17 published fixture profiles before republishing the user's separate profile.
checks.expected_behavior: Published profile becomes discoverable; unpublished profile disappears immediately without a deployment.

checks.method_or_action: Choose Classic, Compact and Warm; choose both optional-section orders; publish and inspect
checks.setup: Use a biography and existing project evidence where available; a default initials avatar is used.
checks.expected_behavior: Three controlled presets, About/Project Evidence ordering and default profile media are available.

checks.method_or_action: Compare skills, availability and directory filter results before/after only changing theme/order
checks.setup: Select non-empty standardized skills and availability; publish each presentation change.
checks.expected_behavior: Presentation changes leave structured search data and matching employer-filter results unchanged.

checks.method_or_action: Enter HTML/script-like text in profile fields, preview and publish; try a non-HTTPS link
checks.setup: Use synthetic harmless sentinel markup and the reviewer's own profile.
checks.expected_behavior: Custom text is rendered as data and cannot execute; public links saved through the editor API are limited to HTTPS.

checks.method_or_action: At a 390 CSS-pixel viewport, complete sign-in, edit, suggestion review, preview and publish/unpublish
checks.setup: Use browser responsive mode at 390 CSS pixels; allow required GitHub navigation and mailbox access.
checks.expected_behavior: Main self-service workflow remains usable without desktop-only controls. This viewport workflow still needs a deployed manual check.

checks.method_or_action: Navigate with keyboard; inspect labels/focus; submit incomplete or invalid fields
checks.setup: Test required fields, rejected domains, wrong codes and missing publish fields.
checks.expected_behavior: Controls have meaningful labels and visible keyboard focus; errors identify corrections.

checks.method_or_action: Exercise R1 public discovery, filter combinations, project evidence and contextual inquiry
checks.setup: Import all R1 JSON fixtures using backend/seed-release1.js. Verify existing legacy fixture IDs and student/project inquiry context.
checks.expected_behavior: R1 discovery, stable routes, published-only profile access, project evidence and contextual simulated inquiry remain functional.

checks.method_or_action: Resolve the assessed tag and compare its full SHA with release_submission.md and the assessed deployment
checks.setup: Create R2-submission on d97c6477f680a6a9b7764aa6107ceb31003c0e0c before Moodle Submit. Team reports an instructor extension to October 18 and no earlier R2 submission. Preserve this tag after submission; document later fixes separately.
checks.expected_behavior: Immutable R2-submission or approved equivalent identifies the original assessed commit; later repairs are recorded separately.

checks.method_or_action: Attempt writes using a second student's identifier through body/query/path variants
checks.role: two students with separate GitHub accounts
checks.setup: Both reviewers control their own accounts; save identifiable separate drafts and retain before/after snapshots. Current canonical routes select ownership from the signed session.
checks.expected_behavior: Server refuses attempts naming another student's profile; no route can change another student's maintained or public data. Explicit identifier rejection still needs a focused check.

checks.method_or_action: Import resume_untrusted_text.pdf; review suggestions without applying; inspect network and profile state
checks.setup: Use the supplied untrusted-text fixture, not a real private resume.
checks.expected_behavior: Resume instructions remain ordinary data; import cannot change publication/privacy or trigger a profile write.

checks.method_or_action: Compare suggestions to each original PDF, especially resume_minimal.pdf
checks.setup: Use all four course PDFs and compare candidate text with the source.
checks.expected_behavior: No skill, employer, date or qualification absent from the PDF is invented; sparse extraction is acceptable.

fixture_setup: R1: root schema.sql creates/extends the PostgreSQL tables; run `node seed-release1.js` from backend with DATABASE_URL configured to load fixtures/students.json, fixtures/projects.json and fixtures/skills.json. Do not erase or reset existing user profiles. The R1 import was completed on 2026-10-17 through the one-time backend build command, then Build Command was restored to npm install. After a further backend redeployment, API reads confirmed 24 shared skills and 17 published fixture profiles. R2: obtain the four synthetic PDFs from Moodle Release 2 Fixtures (folder 3925); select them locally via /profile.html#resume. This implementation does not upload, preload or store original PDFs. Auth/profile tables are added by backend/r2.js using schema.sql.
test_access: Project 1 has public visitors, GitHub-authenticated unverified students and verified students. Reviewers use their own GitHub account and their own approved algomau.ca mailbox; no shared password/token or staff-created account is required. If reviewer-specific setup or repository access is needed, arrange it through the course-approved private channel. No email-verification bypass/test mode is enabled. Repository is public and Issues are enabled; instructor and assigned reviewers must confirm access/issue creation before Submit; credentials and real verification codes must never be committed.

version_status.tag_creation: Create once on assessed_code_commit before Moodle Submit; never move an existing frozen tag.
version_status.submission_status: Team reports no previous R2 submission; instructor extension to October 18 confirmed by the team.
version_status.documentation: Uploaded submission files describe the immutable assessed code; documentation-only branch commits may follow.

request_setup.credentials: include; signed HttpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookie from the GitHub callback
request_setup.profile_identity: Canonical self-service routes have no client-selected profile ID. Public IDs are U followed by the internal UUID.

verification_confirm_body.code: six digits received through the reviewer's private mailbox

verification_evidence.fixture_persistence: 24 shared skills and 17 published fixture profiles confirmed before and after a backend redeployment on Oct 17 Toronto time.
verification_evidence.privacy: Oct 18 unauthenticated detail/directory reads confirmed the published user profile had availability=[] and links={} when both visibility controls were off; no private account/challenge field names were present.
verification_evidence.presentation: Warm/About-first changed to Compact/Project-Evidence-first. Skills and public hidden availability stayed unchanged, and the Accessibility AND Blender filter continued to find the profile.
verification_evidence.limits: Evidence describes the current code prepared under the team-reported October 18 extension. It does not establish every requirement passed; remaining checks/known issues are listed in release_submission.md.
